# Saved notebook ink

`pens-small.rm` is a public reMarkable 2 capture containing nine strokes, one from each stock drawing tool. The saved-notebook tests read the original bytes to check the page layout, layer identity, ink colours and tool rendering. [Original capture and recorded tools](https://github.com/citizen-stig/remarkable-tablet-cli-rs/tree/544968f002f230ff55c5d438e843aab5a5e9c552/crates/remarkable-rm/tests/fixtures)

The file's SHA-256 is `b8f9a83d56fec3fb1d85685ad16442cef477933d412e6ecbb7860e67040c81e6`. [MIT license](../../../docs/licenses/remarkable-rm-MIT.txt)
